t: This is Benjamin Pollock's Toy Shop, in the Market Building at Covent Garden. It sells vintage and retro toys, and it specialises in Victorian toy theatres, both original and reproduction, along with books, puppets and music boxes. The shop began in Hoxton in 1851. In 1877 it was taken over by Benjamin Pollock, who ran it until his death in 1937, and his name is still over the door. Later, the Coronation Street actor Peter Baldwin co-owned it from 1988 until 2015.
